opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search with sort by price
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights from {origin} to {destination} for {trip_type} on {depart_date}/{return_date}, optionally paying with TrueBlue points, then sort the results by lowest price.
steps: Open jetblue.com and select the Flights tab
Type the origin in the From field and pick the airport or city area
Type the destination in the To field and pick the airport
Set the trip type (Roundtrip or One-way) if needed
Pick the depart date and, for a roundtrip, the return date in the calendar
Tick 'Use TrueBlue points' or switch to Points if needed
Click Search flights and confirm any interstitial with 'Continue to flight results'
Open Sort & Filter, choose the price sort option, and click Apply

instances.values: JFK -> MIA, roundtrip Mar 27-Mar 31, switched to Points, sorted by Price by Core
NYC area -> Toronto YYZ, one-way Apr 29, Dollars, sorted Price (low to high)
NYC area -> Aruba AUA, roundtrip May 1-May 5, TrueBlue points, sorted Price (low to high); a Budget detour interrupted it

opportunities.name: United.com rental car search
opportunities.description: Search for a rental car on United.com at {pickup_location} from {pickup_date} to {dropoff_date}, with optional pickup and drop-off times, then launch Find cars.
steps: Open united.com and go to Book > Car
Type the pickup location and pick the matching suggestion
Pick the pickup date and then the drop-off date in the calendar
Optionally change the pickup and drop-off times
Click Find cars

instances.values: Brooklyn - Central (New York), Apr 09-Apr 15, default 10:00 a.m. times

opportunities.name: Avis Budget Group careers job search with filters
opportunities.description: From the Budget site footer, open Avis Budget Group careers and filter openings by {country}, {team}, and {time_type}, then search and optionally open a job.
steps: On budget.com, click Careers in the footer
On the careers site, click Openings
Open the Country filter and select the country
Open the Team filter and select the team
Open the Time Type filter and select the time type
Click Search by job title or keyword
Optionally open a job posting and click Apply Now

instances.values: United States of America, Finance, Full time; opened Accounts Payable Associate
United States of America, Finance, Full time

opportunities.name: MTA bridge and tunnel toll rates by vehicle type
opportunities.description: Go to the MTA Bridges & Tunnels toll pages and open the toll rates for {vehicle_type}.
steps: Open new.mta.info
Go to Bridges & Tunnels tolls, through Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels or through Fares & Tolls > Bridges and Tunnels tolls
Click Toll Rates / Tolls by vehicle
Click the vehicle type tile (Cars, Motorcycles, Trucks)

opportunities.name: NPS Find a Park filtered search
opportunities.description: On the NPS Find a Park page, filter parks by {filter_type} = {filter_value} and run the search.
steps: Open nps.gov and click Find a Park / See All Parks & Search By Map
Open the By Activity or By Topic dropdown
Tick the activity or topic you want
Click Search
